items.mnemonic_text: A roof gathering people below it: a meeting, to meet.
A box repeating the same shape inside: the same.
A hand holding a skewer of tasks: a matter to handle.
A nose pointing at oneself: 'me', self.
An altar (示) marking earth (土): a shrine, and by extension a company.
Legs launching outward from a bow: departure, emitting.
An old man bent over a stick: a person.
Earth (土) twisting like a snake (also): the ground.
A workbench stacked with tools: one's trade, business.
A flag on a pole pointing a direction.
Earth (土) where the sun (陽 implied) opens up a place.
An axe (斤) beside a door (戸): the place where work is done.
A stylized heart shape with three drips of feeling.
Fingers and a wrist branching out: a hand.
An upright frame with pupils inside: an eye.
An open square: a mouth.
A flexed arm pushing: power and strength.
A cart seen from above with an axle: a vehicle.
Rain (雨) with lightning stretching down: electricity.
A horse (馬) waiting where trains stop: a station.
A neck (首) moving down a path: the road, the way.
A roof (广) over a stopping point (占): a shop.
A roof over a pig (豕): the traditional house.
A roof (宀) reaching (至) to enclose a room.
A box enclosing plotted lines: a diagram, a map.
A mouth releasing stacked lines of speech: to say.
Words (言) given a式 (form/ceremony): a formal test.
A horse (馬) inspected all over (侴): to test, examine.
An old man's staff (攵) guiding a child (孝): to teach.
A field (田) sitting over the heart (心): thoughts forming.
A bow (弓) with its string pulled taut: to pull.
Repeated breaths (可可) beside a yawning mouth (欠): a song.
A hand (扌) keeping something steady like a temple (寺): to hold.
A person (亻) directing an official (吏): to use, to employ.
A person (亻) in motion (動): working.
A person (亻) relying on old (昔) favors: to borrow.
Money (貝) replacing (代) what's missing: to lend.
An arrow (矢) hitting the mouth's (口) point: to know for certain.
A woman (女) with her own (台) fresh start: to begin.
Thread (糸) wound to its winter (冬) finish: to end.
Grasping (⺈) at the heart (心): an urgent hurry.
A person (土-like legs) bounding forward: to run.
Wings spread mid-motion: to fly.
Water (氵) poured over first (先) rinse: to wash.
Bad luck (歹) beside a person collapsed: to die.
A wandering road (辶) with a flag (斿) of fun: to play.
Sheep (羊) settling onto the eye's (目) view: to arrive, to wear.
A road (辶) that splits away (韋): to differ.
A bird (隹) landing on a tree (木) with the flock: to gather.
A knife (刂) cutting a shape (另) apart: to separate.
A lamp's flame steady atop its stand: the main, central one.
A mouth (口) atop legs (儿): the elder brother who speaks first.
A cord wound down a post: the younger, lower-ranked brother.
A woman (女) who is already (市-like) senior: the older sister.
A woman (女) not yet (未) grown: the younger sister.
Standing (立) by a tree (木) watching (見): a parent's love.
A person kneeling beside a seal: the color of one's mood.
A mouth (口) not yet (未) full: tasting a bit.
A woman (女) beside her child (子): a fondness, to like.
A twisted shape over the heart (心): a bad feeling.
Big (大) with an extra drop of size: thick, fat.
Thread (糸) drawn out fine over a field (田): thin, detailed.
A cart (車) that passes lightly (圣): not heavy.
A cart's heavy load stacked high: heavy, important.
Two bent bows losing their tension: weak.
A bow (弓) reinforced with a hard shell (虽): strong.
The sun (日) hidden behind sound (音) of night: dark.
The sun (日) beside the moon (月): both lighting up, bright.
A shelter (广) opening onto open ground: wide, spacious.
Water (氵) breaking through a levee (夬): a decisive break.
An old man's (耂) bent posture, deep in thought.
Words (言) matched all around (周): to check, investigate.
Feathers (羽) over white (白): a bird practicing to fly, to learn.
Learning (⺍) opening one's view (見): to remember, realize.
A dying (亡) heart (心) losing its memory: to forget.
A wagon (軍) moving down a road (辶): to carry, one's fortune.
A road (辶) release (关) sending something off: to send.
Two axes (斤斤) weighing shells (貝) of value: quality, substance.
Bamboo (竹) matching (合) the right response: an answer.
A flag (方 side) rallying an arrow's (矢) clan together: family.
Rice (米) measured with a dipper (斗): materials, a fee.
A jewel (王) cut along its natural grain (里): reason, logic.
A heart (心) pierced by a single resolved stroke: certainly necessary.
A woman (女) under a covering (覀): the essential point, needed.
Thread (糸) running straight through the loom (圣): to pass through time.
Thread (糸) sold (売) onward without a break: to continue.
Two people standing side by side: to compare.
Feet advancing (辶) among matched (巽) options: to choose.
Bones (歹) left over after the cut (戔): what remains.
Earth (土) piled ever higher (曽): to increase.
Water (氵) cut down (咸) to less: to decrease.
Threads (糸-like) twisted into something strange: to change.
A dog (犬) squeezing back under a door (戸): to return.
A body (尸) stretching (由) out to reach: to deliver, arrive.
